description: Typesafe AI's Jev / System One typed-judgment API, called over raw HTTP from DAAF scripts. Jev generates no text: it takes a `state` plus a map of typed `questions` and returns vendor-calibrated probabilities — choice (pick one option, with a distribution and confidence), score (position on 2-10 ordered levels, likewise), and noul (probability a yes/no statement is true); an experimental box type locates something in an image. Load when a task mentions Typesafe, TypeSafe AI, Jev, System One, `api.typesafe.ai`, or `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, or wants probability-typed judgments over text or images — classify, rank, verify, or locate, into values code can threshold on. This is an external third-party inference API reached with `requests`, not a DAAF data source or dataset; for research data acquisition use the education/election data-source skills. Not for generating prose, code, or explanations. Not for OCR, transcription, or local image processing (scanned PDFs: pdf-reading).
